targets.recommended_epistemic_category_note: No epistemic suppression is asserted. The failure mode is a TRAINING-PROCEDURE defect (open-loop REINFORCE surrogate), not a substrate ceiling and not an instrument defect.
targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-1046 is the FIRST weakens of any kind on SD-082 (prior record: 0 weakens, 0 experimental posterior entries, overall_confidence 0.828 entirely from literature). C1 -- the consequence-trained readout changing E3's top preference MORE than the same substrate's frozen-init readout -- is a clean, adequately-powered NULL: 0 of 7 ready seeds, mean paired DV -0.0837 against a +0.05 floor. The mirror C1neg fires on 4 of 4 REACHABLE seeds (3 seeds had init_div_in_joint < 0.05, making DV <= -0.05 unattainable by construction; recorded as n_ready_seeds_c1neg_unreachable = 3), routing FAIL -> weakens. MECHANISM, read off the run's own cells and CORRECTED at the Step 7c red-team pass: training made the readout RULE-INVARIANT while leaving it strongly candidate-opinionated -- NOT a collapse toward a candidate-uniform output. trained_head_flip_fraction 0.01807 vs init 0.20076 (11.1x), and the trained pair (intact vs rule-zeroed) diverges only 0.0028-0.0315 against the init pair's 0.0377-0.2115; yet the trained head's cross-candidate modulatory spread is 6.13x-42.80x LARGER than init's on every seed (authority_scale_factor_median is a DIVISOR -- scale_factor = target_range / modulatory_spread, e3_selector.py:3425 -- and raw_score_range_mean is identical between the runners by construction), and pairs.head_effect.argmin_divergence is 0.2058-0.8343 on all 7 seeds. The open-loop REINFORCE surrogate therefore learned a STRONG candidate preference that is essentially INDEPENDENT of rule_state -- the precise inverse of SD-082's asserted content. NO CONTRADICTION with V3-EXQ-1029's confirmed H-selection-authority-bounded: 1029's 0/1694 is off_pair PREFERENCE argmin measured with authority OFF (n_both_committed = 0 across all 40 runners, so no committed argmin existed); 1046 measures with authority ON, and its init pair reproduces 1029's authority-ON on_pair reference, so 1046 CORROBORATES that leg. Diagnostic-purpose, excluded from confidence and conflict scoring.

learning_extracted: SD-082's open-loop REINFORCE surrogate learns a candidate preference that is INDEPENDENT of rule_state. The head is not weak or silent -- its bias is 6-43x LARGER than init's and reorders E3's top preference on 21-83% of raw-identical ticks -- it is simply not rule-conditioned. A successor must attack the rule-conditioning of the credit signal, not the head's capacity or its authority.

A scale FACTOR is a divisor. authority_scale_factor_median smaller on an arm means that arm's modulatory spread is LARGER, not smaller. Reading it as a magnitude inverted the mechanism in the first draft of this autopsy and was caught only by the Step 7c pass recomputing from arm_results against e3_selector.py:3421-3428.

A criterion whose threshold equals its REACHABLE count (C1neg: 4 == 4) is a knife edge, but the bias runs CONSERVATIVE -- it demanded a unanimous sweep. The driver's stated guard ('SEED_MAJORITY is absolute, never a fraction of the realised ready count') governs the DENOMINATOR, not REACHABILITY; reachability is handled separately and honestly by recording c1neg_reachable per seed. Worth knowing that the guard does not cover this mechanism.
